item.description: What I am learning from my first goal-free career break and the space it has created for self-discovery.

item.title: Being in the Himalayas
item.description: I got an opportunity to go for a trek - Everest Base Camp (via Gokyo lakes) in April 2018. Although we couldn’t complete it because of various reasons including health issues, we did spend 11 days surrounded by mountains. I thought of sharing my experience of life in the Himalayas.
